subject: [Surgeway] On-prem connector blocking PoC — request for trial leeway
messages:
From: Liam Park <liam.park@surgeway.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@surgeway.io
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC blocked by on-prem connector - need runway

Hi Ethan,

Quick note from the engineering side at Surgeway — our integration team hit a blocker when attempting to validate the on-prem connector. The connector fails during the handshake step with our SSO middleware; we get intermittent 502s and the vendor library upgrade we planned to test against caused additional compatibility regressions.

We were planning to go live with a limited pilot next week, but the PoC is effectively on hold until our infra team resolves the SSO cert chain issue. That could take 10-12 business days.

Given the delay, can you extend our trial window and top up some sandbox credits so our engineers can finish the validation without the trial expiring mid-investigation? If you can give us an extra two weeks and a small credit boost to run overnight batches, it would help unblock the pilot timeline.

I attached the integration logs and a screenshot. Happy to jump on a quick call with your engineers if that helps.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Park
Head of Integrations, Surgeway
liam.park@surgeway.io
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Park <liam.park@surgeway.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by on-prem connector - need runway

Thanks for the details, Liam — really sorry to hear you’re stuck here. The logs were helpful.

Quick plan:
- I can provision a two-week extension on your sandbox trial starting immediately.
- I’ll ask our ops team to allocate an additional $2,500 in credits (overnight batch capacity) so your team can run repeated test passes while the vendor library is being upgraded.
- We should pair an engineer from Redwood with your team for a 30–45 minute troubleshooting session tomorrow to speed root cause analysis.

Cc’ing Ben and Monica to confirm approvals and to kick off the provisioning. If Ben wants to change the credit amount we can discuss.

Would 11am PT tomorrow for the troubleshooting call work for you?

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by on-prem connector - need runway

Approved — extend the trial by 14 days and add $2,500 in sandbox credits.

Couple of guardrails:
- Credits are for test/validation only; no production usage.
- Extension covers the existing test org only (don’t create new orgs to reset limits).
- If Surgeway requests more than two week extension, have them send a renewal plan with milestones.

Ethan — please proceed and confirm when the extension and credits are live so I can update the deal timeline in HubSpot (DW-4382).

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PoC blocked by on-prem connector - internal provisioning note

Monica — can you please provision the 14-day extension and $2,500 sandbox credit to Surgeway (org id: SURG-907)? Attached are the logs Liam sent.

Requested rollout items:
- Apply extension effective now, end date 2027-06-04 23:59 PT.
- Add $2,500 test credits scoped to the org and tag the spend to deal DW-4382.
- Send a confirmation email to liam.park@surgeway.io and procurement@surgeway.io once done.

I’ll join the troubleshooting call tomorrow at 11am PT.

—Ethan
From: Liam Park <liam.park@surgeway.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@surgeway.io
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC blocked by on-prem connector - need runway

Ethan, Ben — this is excellent, thank you. 11am PT tomorrow works for us. We accept the 14-day extension and the $2,500 sandbox credit.

We’ll run a focused troubleshooting session tomorrow and share a short decision memo after the call outlining next steps and revised go/no-go date.

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the bridge — will follow up with the call invite.

Best,
Liam
